  Dunya usay kehti hai alamdar alamdar

  1
  Pyason ka alamdar hai pyason ka alamdar
  Shabbir ke lashkar ka alamdar alamdar
  Emaan ke liye marne ko tayyar alamdar
  Nusrat ke liye bar sar e paikaar alamdar
  Mashkeeze may pani ka talabgaar alamdar
  Aur haathon ke kat jaane se nachaar alamdar

  2
  Wehdat ki tajalli se nazar jodne waala
  Dunya ke har ek aysh se moo modne waala
  Khyber ki tarha fauj ki hadh todne waala
  Hai maut ka maidan may khareedaar alamdar

  3
  Ye khoon ke bauchaar may ummat ka safina
  Tadpati hai maidan may jab yaade sakina
  Naize pe ye ja padta hai taane huwe seena
  Sun leta hai talwaron ki jhankaar alamdar

  4
  Talwaar si baatil ki girha kholne waala
  Haq baat haqeeqat ke liye bolne waala
  Nazron may hayate abadi tolne waala
  Har lehja shahadat ka talabgaar alamdar

  5
  Milne ka na umeed hai jeena ka na yaara
  Kya jaaniye kis tarha se dhoonda hai sahara
  Sunte hai sakina ne kayi baar pukara
  Mumkin hua kismat se na deedar alamdar

  6
  Mashkeeze se har baar wo girta hua pani
  Raftaar se takrati hai nafson ki rawani
  Chehre se nikharti hui baba ki jawani
  Abbas hai ya hyder e karraar alamdar

  7
  Talwaar sambhali kabhi mashkeeza uthaya
  Darya pe bhi pani ke liye khoon ko bahaya
  Saa'il wo kya cheez ye kaunain pe chaaya
  Chalta hi raha azm ki raftaar alamdar

  8
  Wo sookhi zaban ubhre huwe pyas ke chaale
  Behta hai lahoo jism ke har zakhm hai aale
  Jab haath nahi hai to alam kaise sambhale
  Bhai ko sada deta hai har baar alamdar

  9
  Maidan may jam jaana bahadur ka ye khoon hai
  Khoon chehre pe mal lena shaheedon ka wazoo hai
  Hai gurz gira sar pe to aankhon may lahoo hai
  Ho jata hai yun bhi kabhi nachaar alamdar

  10
  Islam ke jaade hai to emaan ki raahe
  Hai rob o jalaal itna ke tham jati hai aahein
  Jhuk jaati hai ay fazl malayak ki nigahein
  Nazron se bahot ooncha hai darbar alamdar

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/dunya-use-kehti-hai.md')
old = p.read_text()
head, tail = old.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
_, body = tail.split('\\n---\\n', 1)
lines = body.splitlines()[2:]
refrain = 'دنیا اسے کہتی ہے۔۔۔'
groups = [lines[:1], lines[1:8]]
start = 8
for number in range(2, 11):
    size = 4 if number == 5 else 5
    groups.append(lines[start:start+size])
    start += size
assert start == len(lines)
assert [i for i, group in enumerate(groups) if group[-1] == refrain] == [1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10]
roman = \"\"\"Dunya use kehti hai alamdaar alamdaar

Pyaasoṅ ka alamdaar hai pyaasoṅ ka alamdaar
Shabbir ke lashkar ka alamdaar alamdaar
Imaaṅ ke liye marne ko tayyaar alamdaar
Nusrat ke liye bar sar-e-paikaar alamdaar
Mashkize mein paani ka talabgaar alamdaar
Aur haathoṅ ke kat jaane se naachaar alamdaar

Wahdat ki tajalli se nazar jorne waala
Dunya ke har ek aish se muṅh morne waala
Khaibar ki tarah fauj ki had torne waala
Hai maut ka maidaaṅ mein kharidaar alamdaar

Ye khun ke buchhaar mein ummat ka safina
Tarapti hai maidaan mein jab yaad Sakina
Naize pe ye parta hai taane hue sina
Sun leta hai talwaaroṅ ki jhankaar alamdaar

Talwaar si baatil ki giraaṅ kholne waala
Haq baat haqiqat ke liye bolne waala
Nazroṅ mein hayaat-e-abadi tolne waala
Har lahja shahaadat ka talabgaar alamdaar

Milne ka na ummid hai jine ka na yaara
Kya jaaniye kis tarah se dhunda hai sahaara
Sunte haiṅ Sakina ne kai baar pukaara
Mumkin hua qismat se na didaar alamdaar

Mashkize se har baar wo girta hua paani
Raftaar se takraati hai nafsoṅ ki rawaani
Chehre se nikharti hui baaba ki jawaani
Abbaas hai ya Haidar Karraar alamdaar

Talwaar sambhaali kabhi mashkiza uthaaya
Darya pe bhi paani ke liye khuṅ ko bahaaya
Saa'il wo kya chiz ye kaunain pe chhaaya
Chalta hi raha azm ki raftaar alamdaar

Wo sukhi zabaaṅ ubhre hue pyaas ke chhaale
Bahta hai lahu jism ke har zakhm hai aale
Jab haath nahiṅ haiṅ to alam kaise sambhaale
Bhaai ko sada deta hai har baar alamdaar

Maidaan mein jam jaana bahaadur ka ye khuṅ hai
Khuṅ chehre pe mal lena shahidoṅ ka wuzu hai
Hai gurz gira sar pe to aaṅkhoṅ mein lahu hai
Ho jaata hai yuṅ bhi kabhi naachaar alamdaar

Islaam ke jaare haiṅ to imaan ki raaheṅ
Hai raub o jalaal itna ke tham jaati hai aaheṅ
Jhuk jaati hai ae Fazl malaaik ki nigaaheṅ
Nazroṅ se bahut uṅcha hai darbaar alamdaar\"\"\".split('\\n\\n')
roman_blocks = []
source_blocks = []
for i, (source, block) in enumerate(zip(groups, roman, strict=True)):
    verses = block.splitlines()
    if source[-1] == refrain:
        verses.append('Dunya use kehti hai...')
    assert len(verses) == len(source)
    if i:
        verses.insert(0, str(i))
        source = [str(i).translate(str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹')), *source]
    roman_blocks.append('\\n'.join('  ' + verse for verse in verses))
    source_blocks.append('\\n'.join(source))
assert sum(map(len, groups)) == 53
assert [line for line in '\\n\\n'.join(source_blocks).splitlines() if line and not line.isdecimal()] == lines
p.write_text(head + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n\\n'.join(roman_blocks) + '\\n---\\n\\n' + '\\n\\n'.join(source_blocks) + '\\n')
